title: GERT Tool Package Manifest v1
description: Structural contract for gert-package.yaml files with apiVersion: tool-package/v1. Declares a local, on-disk collection of exported tool definitions. Validates structure and types only. Hand-authored per Barbara's ruling (.squad/decisions/archive/barbara-tool-packages-architecture-ruling.md), AR-TP-3 / §3.1. Non-tool assets (docs, dashboards, policy bundles, binaries-as-payload) are not describable by this schema in the MVP — see AR-TP §0.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema declaration for IDE tooling.

dependencies.description: Transitive package dependencies are out of scope in the MVP (AR-TP §0, non-goal). This field is schema-valid at any length so that a non-empty array is diagnosed with the intended, more specific error rather than a generic schema-validation failure: the resolver MUST raise PKG-016 for any non-empty array. An empty array or absent field is accepted with no error.

PackageMeta.description: Package identity. The package root is the directory containing gert-package.yaml.

name.description: Reverse-DNS package name. URL-shaped names (e.g. 'github.com/acme/gert-tools') are rejected as PKG-004 — a name that looks like a location invites a remote fetch that the MVP does not perform.

version.description: Strict SemVer 2.0.0 (see design/gert/sections/06-tool-runtime.tex §Version Constraint Grammar). A leading 'v' is rejected, not stripped (PKG-025).

description.description: Non-normative summary of the package's purpose.

Exports.description: The package's public API surface. A .tool.yaml inside the package that is not listed here is invisible to consumers; referencing it is PKG-011. There is no implicit tools/ directory scan.

tools.description: Exported tool entries. Unique by both 'id' and 'path'.

ToolExport.description: A single exported tool. The qualified catalog name for this export is '<meta.name>/<id>' (AR-TP §3.1).

id.description: Bare tool name exported by the package. MUST equal the referenced .tool.yaml's meta.name (or name); a mismatch is PKG-023.

path.description: Package-root-relative POSIX path to the .tool.yaml definition. Subject to the secure path rules in design/gert/sections/06-tool-runtime.tex §Secure Path Resolution: '/' separator only, no absolute path, no escape above the package root (PKG-007); a missing file is PKG-010.
